propositions: A failed identity write (add_label or set_entity_property) immediately after create_issue succeeds triggers delete_issue, destroying a recoverable unlabelled issue to recover from a labelling failure

The write-ahead binding recorded by record_pending_key at dispatch_one.py:307-308 runs before identity writes, so on failure a KEYED-pending binding survives pointing to a deleted Jira key, stranding the ticket permanently as recover_pending cannot retro-attach
The recover_pending KEYED branch already exists to deterministically retro-attach labels and properties with no Jira search, making the rollback delete redundant with rebar's own recovery machinery

The screen-configuration failure message from Jira is misleading in roughly half the cases: genuinely missing field, jira.permission.createclone.denied workflow property, or malformed value on a field that is on screen
rebar must declare labels as a required Create and Edit screen field rather than implement createmeta-driven pre-flight discovery or unbind on rollback
BindingPersistError branch must not delete either, as an unmarked issue in the project is adopted as a new remote issue on the next inbound pass
